recommendation: Assess and address social determinants of health for hypertension patients
implementation_steps: Assess and address social determinants of health (housing instability, food insecurity, financial barriers)
Provide resource navigation to connect patients with community services
Support behavioral change through motivational interviewing and goal setting
Facilitate access to insurance, medication assistance programs, and community-based services
Coordinate with care team to address identified social barriers
evidence_summary: Social worker interventions addressing social determinants of health have been shown to improve hypertension outcomes by reducing barriers to care, enhancing medication access, and supporting lifestyle modifications in vulnerable populations.
citation: Implementation Strategies to Improve Blood Pressure Control in the United States
